question: GQ-007
subject: a fourth want-list, and three defects it exposed

the_language_filter_worked_on_its_first_.caught: Anselm's Tractatus de praedestinatione et de praescientia Dei — Latin, excluded BEFORE download
the_language_filter_worked_on_its_first_.significance: the check I moved to selection last turn did its job on the very next list

defect_1_manifest_overwrite.symptom: passage index had 334 books, catalogue had 300 — 34 indexed and uncatalogued
defect_1_manifest_overwrite.cause: the manifest filename used slice(0,15) — MINUTE precision. A fetch and its retry landed in the same minute and the retry OVERWROTE the first manifest.
defect_1_manifest_overwrite.damage: the record of 34 fetched books destroyed; text files survived, provenance did not
defect_1_manifest_overwrite.why_it_was_silent: the migration reads manifests, so those 34 simply never appeared — no error anywhere
defect_1_manifest_overwrite.fix: second precision plus a refusal to overwrite an existing path
defect_1_manifest_overwrite.recovery: 34 entries reconstructed from the text files and want-list, labelled RECONSTRUCTED rather than passed off as original

defect_2_dedup_hole.cause: "Medical logic" and "Medical logic [electronic resource]" are the same book scanned twice; the bracket survived normaliseTitle
defect_2_dedup_hole.evidence: 1,151 and 1,143 passages, 339 shared fingerprints between exactly that pair
defect_2_dedup_hole.scale: the title index dropped 75,008 -> 74,965 — 43 duplicate title-forms collapsed, so this was systematic, not one unlucky pair

defect_3_build_ordering.symptom: build-library-page failed with "no such table: passage_modern"
defect_3_build_ordering.cause: rebuilding the passage index drops and recreates the database, destroying the modern-spelling table
defect_3_build_ordering.so: add-longs-variants MUST run between them, and nothing enforced or documented that

the_324_explained: 339 of them are the one duplicate pair. Everything else is 1-3 passages of ordinary quotation, unchanged from 298 books.

rights_gate_consistency.this_list: 69 of 109 excluded as bare "Public Domain" — the same rule, not a new stricture
